Categories.value: Ogv videos|Videos of the New York City Subway|Photographs by See-ming Lee|Video display resolution 1280 x 720|Videos of 2009 from the United States|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|September 2009 in Brooklyn, New York City|New York City Subway in 2009|Flickr videos reviewed by File Upload Bot (Magnus Manske)|FIND displays in New York City Subway cars

ImageDescription.value:
The signage is split into two halves. On the left side of the panel shows where the train is at while the train is stopped (with a flashing bounding box), and when it's in motion, it displays the next stop. The name of the next 10 stops, in yellow, are displayed to the right of 'you are here sign post'. Each station name is accompanied with designation in green which shows the additional lines you can do an interchange. A red handicapped icon designate whether there it is a station equipped with accessibility access.

At the end of the right half of the panel shows the last stop of the train, and the LED displays loops through the rest of the stop in multiple of 10s, so you can get a glance of all the stops while keeping the display small enough so as not requiring an extra large panel for the longer lines.

See SML Pro Blog: New York City Subway LED Signage for complete description, photos and videos.

Categories.value: 1 Line (Sound Transit)|Videos from YouTube|Uploaded with video2commons|Videos of 2014 from the United States|February 2014 in rail transport in the United States|February 2014 in Seattle|License reviewed by YouTubeReviewBot|Videos of trams in the United States

ImageDescription.value:
Since it opened in 2009, Central Link Light Rail has only regularly operated single or 2-car trains, largely because the capacity wasn't needed, and the Downtown Seattle Transit Tunnel won't have space to turn around a 3 or 4-car consist until 2016.
However, when an estimated 700,000 Seahawks Fans descended on Downtown Seattle to celebrate our first Superbowl win, capacity was critical. With fans being turned away by full trains, and massive crowds on platforms, Sound Transit put several 3 and 4 car consists into service between Stadium Station and SeaTac Airport in an unprecedented attempt to handle the load.

ImageDescription.value:
Newsreels in which Dutch subjects of a certain week are presented.
Nowadays the commemoration of the dead from WW II takes place once every five years. Flowers are laid and two minutes of silence are held at the National Monument on Dam square in Amsterdam. Near the war monument of sculptor Fred Carasso in Sprang-Capelle lies one wreath and there is no commemoration. In Waalwijk is a late opening of the shops and at the war monument by John Raedecker is no commemoration. With comments by people about why they don't commemorate and youth of whom some don't know what kind of night it is.

Categories.value: Naval architecture|Vlissingen|Videos of trams|Media from Open Beelden|Traditional clothing of Zeeland|Video display resolution 320 x 240|Polygoonjournaal in 1923|Black and white images of trams

ImageDescription.value:
Een Engels gezelschap van marine ingenieurs (Naval Architects ?) olv Sir Archibald Dewy brengt, vergezeld van hun echtgenotes, een bezoek aan Vlissingen. Zij bezichtigen de stad en een dorp in de omgeving, maken een vaartocht door de haven en rijden per tram door de straten van Vlissingen.

An English company of marine engineers (Naval Architects?), accompanied by their wives and lead by Sir Archibald Dewy, pay a visit to Vlissingen. Div. shots aankomst van schip, pan langs boven- en benedendek met wachtende passagiers die schip vervolgens via loopplank verlaten. Straatshot met delegatie Naval Architects en div. shots hotel met passerende bussen. Div. shots bezoek van gezelschap aan: - stadhuis oa poseren bij bordes; - vissersbuurt waar oa was over straat hangt; - boulevard en haven; - dorpskern naburig dorp met huizen en kerk achter duinen. Div. shots volwassenen en kinderen in klederdracht. 04:17 Div. shots Zeeuws vrouwenkoor olv dirigent en applaudisserend publiek. 05:25 en va 13:35 Sir Archibald Dewy(?). 08:04 Div. vaarshots haven Vlissingen. 12:07 Div. rijshots Vlissingen en omgeving vanuit tram(?) of trein(?).

Several shots of the arrival of the ship, pan along the upper and lower deck with waiting passengers that leave the ship via a gangplank. Street shot with the Naval Architects delegation and several shots of teh hotel with passing busses. Several shots of the visit of the company to: - town hall a.o. posing near the steps; fishermen neighbourhood where a.o. the laundry hangs across the streets; - boulevard and harbour; - village centre of neighbouring village with houses and church behind dunes. Several shots of adults and children in traditional attire. 04:17 Several shots Zeeland womens choir lead by a conductor and applauding audience. 5:25 and from 13:35 Sir Archibald Dewy(?). 08:04 Several sailing shots of the harbour of Vlissingen 12:07 Several driving shots of Vlissingen and surrounding area taken from a tram(?) or train(?).

ImageDescription.value:
Newsreels in which Dutch subjects of a certain week are presented.
The Netherlands wins a friendly soccer match with 2-1 against West Germany in the Rhein stadium in Düsseldorf in the snow. It's the first postwar international match against West Germany. With the Dutch players Coy Koopal (debutant), Jan Notermans (debutant), Abe Lenstra (0-1 and 0-2), Bram Appel, Frans de Munck (goalkeeper) en Cor van der Hart (1-2/an own goal), the German goalkeeper Fritz Herkenrath and the English referee Reginald Leafe. After the match the Dutch supporters storm the field and carry the players in triumph. Also footage of Düsseldorf and supporters taking the tram to the stadium.

ImageDescription.value: [recorded 11/23/2015 with Appalation Elevators] As you can tell from this video, this is my first time on an incline! Being blind, I don't usually think about viewing things, although I did notice the glass doors, and filmed out of them. So in retrospect, it probably makes me look like an idiot for not figuring out how the counterweight could be viewed (out the glass door, of course...). But as I said, I don't usually think about how to "view" things. Beside that, there was a glitch where the car didn't initially accept my car call, as you will see. Other than that, I really enjoyed the experience of riding my first incline elevator. As you will notice, Having an incline elevator to ourselves leaves plenty of time for naration. :)

ImageDescription.value: У Львові відновлюють старий електротранспорт. Так, модернізований трамвай Tatra KT4 № 1053 1984 року випуску, у якому встановили нові панорамні вікна, замінили електрику і обшивку, вже виїхав на випробування. Також тривають аналогічні роботи щодо іншого трамваю. Незабаром обіцяють завершити відновлення тролейбуса. Як розповів міський голова Львова Андрій Садовий, ЛКП «Львівелектротранс» на відновлення однієї машини необхідно орієнтовно 1,5 місяці.

Тверской трамвай. Трамвайный парк Соминка. Осмотр вагонов.
В 1960-е года трамвайная система Твери расширилась до 150 вагонов, а депо № 1, рассчитанное на обслуживание 100 вагонов, не справлялось с таким объемом работ. ImageDescription.value:
Newsreels in which Dutch subjects of a certain week are presented.
Employees of the Dutch Red Cross get the Jaarbeurs halls in Utrecht ready for the relief of 670 Hungarian refugees, who fled Hungary after the invasion of the USSR. Around 11PM the train with the refugees arrives at Utrecht Central Station, after which they go to the Jaarbeurs halls by bus. In the Margriet hall they receive something to drink and minister J.G. Suurhoff of Social Affairs talks to some of them. After that they are registered.

ImageDescription.value: Pengawal Gerak - Gerik Moesoeh di Laoet; Japanse propagandafilm (1941-1945). Japanse propagandafilm over de waakzaamheid van de Japanse militairen en bevolking, en hoe er wordt gereageerd op de dreiging van een Amerikaanse luchtaanval. Te zien is o.a. de berichtenstroom nadat Amerikaanse vliegtuigen zijn gesignaleerd, de opstelling van luchtafweergeschut en de toestroom van burgers in schuilkelders nadat het luchtalarm is afgegaan.; "NB: Deze film is onderdeel van een collectie Japanse films ingezet door de propaganda-afdeling van het Japanse leger tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog in Azië, waarbij Nederlands-Indië (nu Indonesië) door Japan werd bezet van 1942-1945. Kort na de Japanse capitulatie van 15 augustus 1945 zijn deze Japanse propagandafilms door de terugkerende Nederlandse autoriteiten in Indonesië geconfisqueerd en naar Nederland verscheept. De films zijn vrijgegeven door het Nederlands Instituut voor Beeld en Geluid na onderzoek in samenwerking met NHK Enterprises (Japanse Publieke omroep) in 2020. Deze films kunnen onjuiste, eenzijdige en politiek extreme ideeën bevatten. Please note: This film is part of a collection Japanese films used by the propaganda department of the Japanese military administration during the Pacific War, when the former Dutch East Indies (Indonesia now) were occupied by Japan from 1942-1945. Soon after the Japanese capitulation in August 1945 these films were confiscated by the returning Dutch authorities in Indonesia and shipped to the Netherlands. The films were released by the Netherlands Institute for Sound and Vision after research in cooperation with NHK Enterprises (Japanese Public Broadcaster) in 2020. These videos might reflect erroneous, biased or politically extreme ideas." ImageDescription.value:
Newsreels in which Dutch subjects of a certain week are presented.
Everything is slowly coming back to normal in the Dutch East Indies. In the working-class area Tanah Abang, on the border of Batavia, a market is held. Categories.value: Media from YouTube|Maps of the New York City Subway|Files from external sources with reviewed licenses|Videos from YouTube|Uploaded with video2commons|Diagrams of New York City|Videos of the New York City Subway|Videos of diagrams|Video display resolution 554 x 720

ImageDescription.value:
24 hour simulation of the New York City subway system (MTA trains only).

The New York City Subway system has 421 stations and a total line length of 321km making it the largest system in America and #4 worldwide.

Each bullet in the simulation represents a train. Displayed is typical Tuesday traffic without service disruptions in the pre-Sandy era (timetable data from 2012; 1 to South Ferry; R tunnel open; normal Rockaway service).

Diamond 6 and 7 services are displayed in round signets.

The traincount displayed at the bottom shows how many trains are in service at one time in the whole system: This is a minimum number of actual real trains, because trains reversing and waiting for their next trip at their respective terminal stations are neither displayed nor counted.

Thanks to the MTA for making their timetable data availible to the public.

Map image from OpenStreetmap.

ImageDescription.value: The Metro 1 (Officially: Millennium Underground Railway or M1) is the oldest line of the Budapest Metro system. Known in Budapest simply as "the underground" ("a földalatti"), as the M2, M3 and the now being built M4 are called "metró". It is the second oldest underground railway in the world (the first being the London Underground's Metropolitan Line), and the first on the European mainland. It was built from 1894 to 1896. ImageDescription.value:
Tampines West | Singapore Skyline

Have you ever wondered how does the Singapore Skyline looks like over the span of a day from a distance or do the CBD buildings or the Singapore Sports Hub ever switch off their exterior lights or how about when does the Singapore Flyer start and stop operation? Shot over the weekend of Earth Hour 2016 for a span of 24 hours, featuring a Day to Night to Day transition; one can see the full effects of Earth Hour (or lack of), the change in visibility of the skyline as time progresses, the non-stop movement of lights of apartments and even The Ritz-Carlton for the matter. Please view in HD for best viewing experience.

The New York City Police Department is asking for the public's assistance in identifying the individual depicted in the attached video and photograph in connection to a robbery that occurred within the confines of the 7 Precinct/Transit District 4. Details are as follows:

The individual then threw hot coffee on the two victims before he ran up the stairs to the street area and fled westbound on Delancey Street. The two victims refused medical attention at the scene.

The individual is described as a: • Male black, 45 to 55 years old, with facial hair and salt and pepper hair; last seen wearing a dark colored long sleeved shirt and light colored jeans.

Anyone with information in regards to this incident is asked to call the NYPD's Crime Stoppers Hotline at 1-800-577-TIPS (8477) or for Spanish, 1-888-57-PISTA (74782). ImageDescription.value: Bioscoopjournaals waarin Nederlandse onderwerpen van een bepaalde week worden gepresenteerd.; De enorme verkeersdrukte op het Muntplein te Amsterdam wordt al jarenlang vanuit een controlepost, enkele meters boven de grond, geregeld door verkeersagenten. Categories.value: Files from external sources with reviewed licenses|Videos from YouTube|Uploaded with video2commons|Videos of 2021 from Slovenia|Bus line 6 (Ljubljana)|Videos of buses in Ljubljana|Videos of road transport in Ljubljana

ImageDescription.value:
Da die Slowenische Hauptstadt Ljubljana (Laibach) über kein Straßenbahnnetz verfügt, war es nötig ein effektives Busnetz zu entwickeln.

Die Bus-Ära beginnt 1951 mit der Eröffnung 4 Trolleybus Linien, die die Straßenbahn ersetzten. Bis zum Ende 60er Jahre wurden alle 4 Linien eingestellt und durch Busse ersetzt. Das Netz wuchs ständig und war im Gleichgewicht zu der Entwicklung der Stadt.

Heute zählt Ljubljana 32 Linien die Ljubljana und ihre Metropolregion gut miteinander verbinden. Die Flotte besteht aus 213 Bussen, die zu 90% niederflurig, klimatisiert und mit Videoüberwachung ausgestattet sind. Am häufigsten sind Mercedes Benz und MAN Busse anzutreffen, während Iveco und Isuzu Minibusse sehr stark in der Unterzahl liegen.

ImageDescription.value: De herdenking van de doden uit WO II vindt tegenwoordig eens in de vijf jaar plaats. Bij het Nationaal Monument op de Dam te Amsterdam worden bloemen gelegd en twee minute stilte gehouden. Bij het oorlogsmonument van beeldhouwer Fred Carasso in Sprang-Capelle ligt één krans en er wordt geen herdenking gehouden. In Waalwijk is het koopavond en bij het oorlogsmonument van John Raedecker is er geen herdenking. ImageDescription.value:
Newsreels in which Dutch subjects of a certain week are presented.
Because of the cuts in spending in 1957, the construction of the IJtunnel in Amsterdam has stopped and the building site is covered in weeds. In the railway above the building site movable bridges have been placed and the Wibautstraat, the eastern access road that connects to the tunnel, is almost finished. At the Weesperstraat the road narrows and the houses that are still there are being demolished. Also aerial shots of the IJ in Amsterdam and Amsterdam North on the other side. At the Central Station, people change from the tram to bus K to the De Ruyterkade (tram). Then they change to the ferry that sails the other side, where they change to the bus. Cars drive via a detour to the bridge across the IJ near Schellingwoude.

ImageDescription.value:
Newsreels in which Dutch subjects of a certain week are presented.
Great public interest at the opening of the Pollak theatre, invited guests and the public crowd round the entrance. - half total pan shot along the new Pollak theatre, build in the style of the Amsterdam School, on the corner of the Parade and the Nassaustraat. (During the war, in 1944, the building is bombed and destroyed). - at 00:23 close up Pollak sr - at 00:34 close up Pollak jr - at 00:46 close up Cornet, director of the theatre - at 01:00 close up unknown man - at 01:07 shot of three unknown men - at 01:19 close up unknown man and mrs. Paulien Tobben, domestic staff of the theatre - at 01:29 a small open lorry with registration number P 8796 enters the Nassaustraat, driven by Pollak jr.. In the background the Wapenarsenaal van de Cavalerie (Armoury of the Cavalry), which was taken down at the end of the 1930s, 25". - Business at the Parade, people arrive by cars and buses, a.o. the bus of the regular service form Eindhoven - Veldhoven, people on bicycles, 35". Crowd with mostly men. - High shot of the arrival of cars with invited guests in front of the building, lots of spectators, 25". - at 02:55 medium shot of the guests going in, on the left side officer Geurts, 16". - at 03:11 medium shot of the arrival of a class, group of school kids or orphans, with black caps, followed by men with hats, 58". The man, of the upper middle class type, who escorts the boys is Teeuwissen, notables in Venlo - several high shots of the large crowd in front of the building, 32". Note: SOURCE: Huub Mans, editorial staff NOS Gewest programmes.

ImageDescription.value: Сплотка из трёх электропоездов 81-722/723/724 «Юбилейный» (двух базовой модели и одного модификации .3) на станции Нарвская Петербургского метрополитена. Осуществляется перегонка электропоезда в середине состава, прошедшего текущий ремонт 3-го объёма (ТР-3) на Октябрьском электровагоноремонтном заводе (ОАО «ОЭВРЗ»), из электродепо ТЧ-1 «Автово» в ТЧ-5 «Невское». По правилам, только что выпустившиеся с завода/прошедшие ремонт электропоезда, запрещено перегонять «своим» ходом через не «свои» линии. В связи с этим, перегонка среднего состава осуществлялась в обесточенном состоянии двумя другими. «Замыкающий» электропоезд модификации .3, поскольку весь состав следовал до станции «Площадь Восстания», потребовался для возможности оборота состава на присутствующей там служебной соединительной ветви (ССВ) на Невско-Василеостровскую (зелёную или 3-ю ) линию. После её прохождения, сменив кабину управления и выехав на I гл. путь 3-й линии, состав отправился в в ТЧ-5 «Невское» (за станцией «Рыбацкое»), к которому весь, собственно, и приписан.

We made this Hyper-Lapse/Flowmotion during a week-long trip to Budapest. We definitely wanted to showcase Budapest's incredibly photogenic streets, and show you this iconic city in a unique and creative way.

We partnered with Visit Budapest to promote the Budapest Card and thought it would be a fun and clever way to use their cards to emphasize how much you can see and do in a short time with the Budapest Card. Six Days of Shooting - Over 5,000 photos and 295 GB's of Data make up this video. Eight Days of editing. Using Lightroom and LRTime-lapse to color correct the time-lapse sequences. After Effects to stabilize and do the effects, and premiere to do the audio and finishing touches. These are passion projects of love as we continue to grow our video production services. Many of these time-lapse sequences are shot in 8K, so if you have any licensing questions or would like to use some of the time-lapses or would like to hire us to make a video like this for you please send inquiries to hello@boboandchichi.com If you liked this video, it would mean the world to use if you would share it. ImageDescription.value: Edited views of San Francisco, taken from a Philip Greene film produced by Richard Moore and Zev Putterman for KQED in 1973, which features aerial views of California's coastline from Mt. Shasta to Los Angeles. Greene's title is taken from a poem by Robinson Jeffers, which celebrates the majesty of California's Pacific coastline. Richard Moore quotes Jeffers directly in voice over as a preface to the film: "This place is the noblest thing I have ever seen. No imaginable / Human presence here could do anything / but dilute the lonely self-watchful passion." Includes extended views of: Mt. Shasta; coastal and marine wildlife; the logging industry; Mendocino; Sacramento; San Francisco; Monterey; Big Sur; Salinas Valley; surfing; skateboarding; Malibu and Los Angeles. The film's sound was edited by four time Oscar winner Mark Berger.

ImageDescription.value: Usage of Videomaut toll system in Austria. The film shows the approach to and passing of the northbound Videomaut lane at Schönberg toll station on the A13 motorway in Austria. Note the speed limit and the camera mounted to the left of the lane. The number plates of the two vehicles ahead are not recognised by the system, and these vehicles are re-routed into a cashier-operated lane. The LED readout displays "Nicht erkannt" (not recognised) and an arrow pointing to the right for these vehicles, while it displays "Berechtigt" (authorised) for the vehicle the film is recorded from.

ImageDescription.value:
Newsreels in which Dutch subjects of a certain week are presented.
A depression causes fog and thaw. A lonely skater skates on the canal, the inland vessels work their way through the frozen canals. The Christmas lights in the shopping streets are already on. A train passes a level crossing. The mist and the iciness causes problems for the traffic on the road, amongst them a crashed police car. Airplanes stand still at Schiphol Airport.

ImageDescription.value:
Muni bus 5010 is a 2022 Nova Bus LFSe+ model that is one of three in the fleet. It has a rear window, plug doors with exterior door buttons, and a visual display that only displays it was an electric bus pilot program since the program started on February 8, 2022. It consists of three buses of each manufacturer (NFI XE40, BYD K9MD, Proterra ZX5, and Nova Bus LFSe+). There is not a seat immediately behind the driver's seat.
At 1:30, the bus stops at a red light while running the 15 Bayview Express route, waiting until the green light at video time 1:40. A stop request was made at 1:42.1, and the bus arrives at 3rd St and Mission St at 1:52.8. The green light on the rear door appeared at about 1:53.17, but the driver opens the door at 1:54.56, even if there is yellow tape present. No one touched the yellow tape to open the door, which made the audio announcement "Doors are opening", and exited the bus. This video was taken at about 2:38 pm on May 21, 2023.
